rationale: No ClinicalStudy/ClinicalTrial type exists in the frozen model.
Sponsor is representable as an Organization; sponsor-specific role semantics remain relation-dependent.
AACT trial site maps to Facility without conflating Organization.
Country/location semantics are represented in X-INFRA.
Pharmaceutical interventions can be represented, but generic ClinicalTrials.gov interventions also include non-pharmaceutical interventions and intervention context is absent.
A coded diagnosis reference is available, but a general study-condition entity is not.
Generic ObservationResult is not treated as equivalent to a clinical study outcome.
No study arm/group type is present.
No clinical study phase semantic type is present.
No explicit clinical-study lifecycle status semantic type is present.
Aggregate counts can be represented generically, but trial-enrollment semantics are not explicit.
No Study-Sponsor relation exists because Study is absent.
No Study-conducted-at-Facility relation exists.
Facility/geography relation is directly available.
No Study-investigates-Intervention relation exists.
No Study-concerns-Condition relation exists.
No Study-has-Outcome relation exists.
No Study-has-Arm/Group relation exists.
No Study-phase/status relation exists.
The held-out shortage case is directly representable as a time/context-bounded shortage situation.
Product semantics are directly represented.
Generic/substance semantics are directly represented.
Presentation/package identity and source identifiers are available.
Company is representable as Organization.
Availability is representable as an observation result, but the source field may be a report/status string rather than an independently modeled observation activity/result pair.
Shortage reason can be retained as evidence/assertion text but has no dedicated domain reason type.
Therapeutic categories fit the classification pattern.
Dosage-form semantics are directly represented.
Strength semantics are directly represented.
Shortage lifecycle status/update state lacks a dedicated status pattern.
Dedicated shortage-to-product relation exists.
Dedicated shortage-to-presentation relation exists.
Organization/product/source semantics exist, but no dedicated company-to-shortage reporting/affected-product relation captures the source field exactly.
No explicit shortage-has-reason/cause property exists.
Product/category assignment is represented.
Temporal primitives exist, but initial posting, update, change and discontinuation dates have distinct source/provenance semantics not fully typed.
Shortage is explicitly jurisdiction-contextualized.
Essential-medicine status is contextual rather than an intrinsic medicinal-product kind.
NLEM entries are often medicine/active-moiety level rather than marketed-product identity; mapping must preserve this ambiguity.
Dosage-form semantics are directly represented.
Strength semantics are directly represented.
List/scheme/version can be represented using classification and release infrastructure.
India can be represented as a country and as the distinct jurisdictional context of the list.
Therapeutic sections fit the classification pattern.
P/S/T levels can be retained as classification values, but healthcare-level applicability is not a first-class semantic type.
The essential assignment targets MedicinalProduct explicitly; substance/active-moiety level NLEM entries need a broader target pattern.
Dedicated contextual-classification jurisdiction relation exists.
List membership/scheme are represented, but a direct versioned-list assignment relation is not explicit.
Form/strength distinctions exist through ProductPresentation, but NLEM medicine entries may be active-moiety level rather than marketed presentations.
Therapeutic section assignment is representable but may require a product-vs-substance target choice.
No explicit medicine-applicable-at-healthcare-level relation exists.
